headline: Every language at once
highlights: Script Match handles mixed-language sessions: each clip's language is identified individually and matched against its own language's script column.
Localization workbooks map themselves — language sheets recognized, Filename and Script columns pre-picked, per-language file names supported.
Near-verbatim matches are unstealable, and the review list is a real keyboard list: visible selection, click-to-select, ↑↓ with auto-play and skip-silence.
